sites.name: Shackleton Rim
sites.description: Centre of the PGDA site DEM Site04 (PGDA name: 'Shackleton rim'), a 16 km tile. This is a tile centre, not a landing or rim point. Height sampled from the 5 m DEM above the 1737.4 km reference sphere. Barker, M.K., et al. (2021) Planetary and Space Science 203:105119, doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119.
